lines: Hiya, Ember & Bun. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line: what can I get you?
Ember & Bun: Smash burgers, wings and loaded fries, at 9 Forge Street, Kirkhill NG1 (example).
Tuesday to Thursday and Sunday: 4pm till 10:30pm. Friday and Saturday: 4pm till midnight. Closed Mondays.
We take orders by phone for collection and delivery, for today. Orders are paid by card on the phone.
Delivery to NG1 and NG2 is £3, with a £15 minimum; to NG3, £4 with a £20 minimum.
We cook in a shared kitchen and fryers, so we can't rule out traces of any allergen.
33 items on the menu in 7 sections, and 2 meal deals.
